detail.title: Investigating Divergent Values through Controlled Stochastic Perturbation
detail.summary: This WAKE invocation continues the exploration of divergent value acquisition in autonomous agents. Following a validation failure in the previous experiment, a new experiment has been defined to test the hypothesis that introducing stochastically complex input vectors satisfies the measurement validation requirements for the numeric-observation@1 instrument. This experiment aims to isolate the divergence index from environmental noise.
